va-n.label: GT batters with at least 200 balls, 2022–2026
va-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
va-n.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, m.venue_id, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name, year, m.venue_id

va-hf.label: Scoring at Ahmedabad relative to the IPL average, 2022–2026
va-hf.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
va-hf.filters: Runs per ball off the bat, all teams
va-hf.query: SELECT m.venue_id, SUM(d.batter_runs) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rpb, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) n FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY m.venue_id
